summary: Pearson plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting only routine total voting rights and capital data as of 30 September 2026. The UK issuer disclosed 601,794,060 ordinary shares of 25p each admitted to trading, each carrying one vote, with no shares held in Treasury. The figure is the denominator for FCA Disclosure and Transparency Rules notifications of interest changes. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event appears. This is an ordinary ongoing-disclosure filing, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
